fts 0.15.7 - commands for a project consuming the FTS platform packages.

  fts feed init [--feed <url|folder>] [--no-token] [--probe-package <id>]
      Write this directory's nuget.config, then PROVE it with a real package restore.
      why not just dotnet: `dotnet nuget add source` writes a source and cannot tell you
      that the token you just gave it passes the index and fails every download.

  fts auth status | fts auth use <github-login> | fts auth reset
      Check package access or save an FTS-only GitHub account preference; no token is saved.

  fts setup auth --status | --local [--dry-run] | --disable-local [--dry-run]
      Assess or manage the versioned, Development-only application JWT profile in user secrets.
      If status reports missing/stale dependency evidence, explicitly restore the generated solution
      with its selected feed/account, then repeat status; missing assets do not prove an old runtime.
      Existing external/custom authentication is preserved; `fts auth` remains package access.

  fts new api <Name> [--interactive | --no-interactive] [-o <dir>] [--feed <url|folder>] [--no-token] [--skip-feed-check]
                     [--auth <none|jwt>] [--db <none|sqlite|postgres>] [--data-access <ado|dapper|efcore|none>] [--tenancy <fixed|claims>]
                     [--audit <none|sqlite|postgres>] [--events <none|inproc>] [--features <none|configuration|sqlite|postgres>]
                     [--files <none|filesystem|s3|azure-blob|custom>] [--files-local <bool>] [--jobs <none|inline|sqlite|postgres>]
                     [--notifications <none|console|sqlite|postgres>] [--profile <demo|protected>]
                     [--notification-transport <custom|webhook>]
                     [--effects <best-effort|atomic>]
                     [--identity-provider <generic|keycloak|supabase|clerk>] [--auth-infra <auto|external|local>]
                     [--permissions <claims|sql|custom>]
      Auto infrastructure generates local recipes for Keycloak and Supabase. Clerk uses hosted infra
[truncated]
